messages:
deploy-bot: Starting production deploy
Environment: production
Tag: v2.20.1
Commit: a1b2c3d4e5f6
Initiated by: @kia
Services: api, inference-runtime, ui
Strategy: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%
Release notes: https://console.redwood.ai/releases/v2.20.1
Estimated rollout: 15m
:rocket:

kia: kicking off canary. monitoring logs + latency dashboards.

sam: watching request errors and p95/p99 latency. will call out regression if seen.

ops-oncall: on standby, alert thresholds set to 2x baseline. ping me if error-rate > 0.5%.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 10% — healthy checks passing (5m)
Checks: heartbeats OK, error-rate within baseline, tail-latency +2ms
Next: promote to 50%

jen: flagged that search-service was flaky in staging yesterday (indexing lag). thinking we should pin it for prod.

kia: good catch. pin search-service to v1.8.3 for this rollout. applying override now.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: search-service -> v1.8.3
Command: ```kubectl set image deploy/search search=registry.redwood:v1.8.3 --record```
Scope: prod-only override

sam: metrics look stable after the pin — no spike in errors.

deploy-bot: Promoting to 50% — rollout progressing
Progress: 2/4 shards updated
Observability: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/deploy/1732101234

deploy-bot: Promoting to 100% — finishing final shard updates

deploy-bot: Rollout complete — 100% traffic
Duration: 12m
Status: SUCCESS :white_check_mark:
Tag: v2.20.1
Commit: a1b2c3d4e5f6
Notes: pinned search-service to v1.8.3 to avoid transient indexing errors
If regressions occur, rollback with: `deploy rollback v2.20.0 --env production`

kia: tagged release in repo and pushed short release notes to #announcements.

ops-oncall: will monitor for 1h. no alerts so far.

jen: thanks everyone — opening a follow-up ticket to investigate search-service fix and remove pin in the next patch.

sam: :thumbsup:
